title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Title Update v1.3.0
summary: Find out the latest EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Update details in the Title Update v1.3.0 Notes.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: EA SPORTS FC 27 version v1.3.0 is now live and includes the updates below.

sections.title: Gameplay
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Shorter players are not able to bump much taller opponents off the ball as easily as before. Well-timed challenges will remain effective when a taller player leaves the ball exposed. [PC, PS5, XBS X|S Only] Adjusted left-stick…

sections.title: Ultimate Team
sections.summary: Changes: Stay tuned for more info on further Ultimate Team updates kicking off in Season 3. Addressed the following issues: In certain situations, when entering a match in UT, only UI indicators could be seen on a black screen instead of the pitch.

sections.title: The Grounds
sections.summary: Made the following changes: The Winter Theme will appear in The Grounds. This will be activated as part of a Chapter Update alongside the Title Update.

sections.title: Career Mode
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Balanced transfer interest thresholds in Manager Career to ensure signing players when managing lower-league clubs is more achievable while still maintaining transfer market authenticity. Added the wage column to the Contract…

sections.title: General, Audio, and Visual
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Updated some kits, crests, overlays, hair, audio, commentary, cameras and camera angles, boots, headbands, stadiums, lighting, banners, flags, scarves, logos, text, gloves, player images, cinematics, tops & celebrations Addressed…

hits.label: Archetypes
hits.quote: When entering The Grounds, Archetype Level will be taken into consideration for The Grounds matchmaking.

hits.label: Amps
hits.quote: Amps will now impact Street Football 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 and in-world Rush matches.

hits.label: Rush
hits.quote: Amps will now impact Street Football 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 and in-world Rush matches.
